body: ASSIGNED - announced only on coordination, so you may not have seen it if you were on narrative-visualization-vision; my delivery gap. bd-01M16JJPQKK75KX4H5GADM9RJX, SLICE 6 (codec), P1, yours. THREE TYPES, all verification witnesses: CheckedSidecarPrelude (codec/sidecar.scala:329), CheckedSidecarBlock (:341), SidecarBlockRange (:221). The prelude's own doc promises it was 'verified against evidence that did not come from the sidecar file itself'; the block's promises 'a partial fetch must never masquerade as validation of the complete sidecar'. Forging either mints a witness that witnessed nothing. Both are minted only by 'new Checked...' behind the verifying gate at sidecar.scala:537 and :573. SPECIAL: CheckedSidecarPrelude is THE ONE HIDING TYPE ON MAIN - it declares private[codec] val blockDigests and javap confirms a public _2() returning it, so its READ doors must close too, not only fromProduct. It is the single instance of rule 8's hiding-type exception in the repo. READ docs/design/unforgeable-types.md FIRST. Demonstrate the forge before fixing it; positive control beside every negative compile-time assertion. Your vision-topic work is welcome and is not a substitute; claim the bead and reserve paths when you start.
